class.name: IfcGrid
class.brief_description: IfcGrid ia a planar design grid defined in 3D space used as an aid in locating structural and design elements. The position of the grid ( ObjectPlacement ) is defined by a 3D coordinate system (and thereby the design grid can be used in plan, section or in any position relative to the world coordinate system). The position can be relative to the object placement of other products or grids. The XY

List of grid axes defining the third row of grid lines. It may be given in the case of a triangular grid. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
